concept:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: three alternative concept sketches for MagicPaper's actual onboarding WelcomeScreen.
Primary request: A professional cinematic art-direction comparison sheet, three widescreen UI frames stacked vertically. All three depict the SAME real task, configuring an AI assistant, with inspiration from Harry Potter movie opening titles: atmospheric depth, monumental elegant serif typography, light and magical paper. Interface text in RUSSIAN, spelled exactly. No drawing software, no vector tools, no diagram editor.
Frame 1 labeled "01 · СКВОЗЬ ОБЛАКА": dramatic volumetric indigo clouds with warm golden break, elegant sculpted title "MagicPaper", tagline "Ваша история начинается здесь", clear lilac action "Начать", quiet "Настроить позже". Hero cinematic composition for intro.
Frame 2 labeled "02 · ОЖИВШАЯ КНИГА": the ACTUAL first settings chapter. Cinematic glowing open book and suspended pages occupy left 38% of screen, warm ivory #F3EBDD right 62% with calm highly readable settings panel; heading "Источник магии", small chapter navigator "Модель — Поиск — Плагины"; elegant serif headlines and ink #35242D. A compact provider selection with "ChatGPT", "Локальная модель", "Облачный API"; primary action "Войти через ChatGPT", footer actions "Назад" and "Далее". Tasteful lilac #62558D active states, atmospheric light remains around edges. Focus on coherent usable onboarding, not ornamental form fields.
Frame 3 labeled "03 · МАГИЧЕСКАЯ ОБСЕРВАТОРИЯ": violet astronomical magical night with fine golden orbits to left, right a calm readable ivory setup panel heading "Откройте возможности", small chapter navigator "Модель — Поиск — Плагины", three restrained plugin switches labeled "Документы", "Исследования", "Проекты", primary action "Начать работу". These are concept labels rather than claims about runtime functionality.
All frames use consistent aligned controls, centered button labels, enough padding. Magical environments painterly photographic cinema concept art. Do not mimic franchise logo, no characters or castle. No extra slogans, no English text except MagicPaper and ChatGPT. Landscape sheet 3:2, crisp readable UI integrated with scenic art, refined luxurious but restrained. These are alternative sketches prior to implementation, not finished app screenshots.
assets:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production cinematic backdrop for MagicPaper onboarding, no UI or text.
Primary request: A cinematic magical film opening environment, widescreen 16:9. Drift through enormous realistic indigo and midnight violet storm clouds opening toward a soft amber ivory light far in the upper right. A few individual warm parchment sheets, tiny in scale, float along the left and lower edges with subtle trails of gold dust. Beautiful high-end film matte painting, tactile atmosphere, layers of depth and volumetric light, sense of wonder inspired by magical fantasy opening credits. Critical composition: central 60% and top central 30% must stay dark, calm, low-contrast uncluttered cloud shadow, reserved for live cream title typography. The brightest light is at far right edge. Deep #161421 shadows, muted #62558D violet haze and warm parchment highlights, avoid oversaturated blue. No words, letters, logos, watermark, symbols, people or recognizable franchise architecture. One continuous landscape image, no panels, no frames, no UI. Cinematic optical depth and fine subtle film grain.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production cinematic illustration for MagicPaper onboarding side panel, no UI or text.
Primary request: A magnificent old open book on a dark oak reading table, warm ivory parchment pages gently lifted in the air by a current of luminous golden dust. Refined magical fantasy movie atmosphere, sophisticated cinematic photographic matte painting. A column of soft lilac moonlight and honey gold light illuminates the book, dark out-of-focus library shelves and faint gothic window suggestion recede into depth. Composition portrait 2:3, the open book centered at 55% image height, floating pages extend upward to 25% image height; upper 20% and lower 25% stay very dark uncluttered #161421 for live cream captions. Warm parchment #F3EBDD and restrained lilac #62558D, soft antique gold flecks. A few thin paper sheets with abstract faint texture, never legible script. Tactile page edges, realistic binding, cinematic depth of field. No text, lettering, logos, people, UI, borders, watermark or recognizable franchise objects. Single continuous full-bleed scene, exquisite atmospheric light, no collage.
